header: The DATE column of a roster is the rightmost box of the table, cut by horizontal rules into merged cells, one per check-up day. The date is printed inside each cell; the cell's top and bottom rules say exactly which rows it covers.

members.name: rules
doc: x of every vertical rule of the table, left to right (left border, column rules, right border)

symbols.name: findFrame
symbols.sig: export function findFrame(g: Gray): Frame | null
doc: Finds the table frame: the vertical rules that run (nearly) the whole height of the table.

members.name: openTop
doc: true when the cell is cut by the top or the bottom of the table (it goes on over the page break)

symbols.name: findDateCells
symbols.sig: export function findDateCells(g: Gray, frame: Frame): { band: { xL: number; xR: number }; cells: DateCell[]; rules: Line[] } | null
symbols.returns: { band: { xL: number; xR: number }; cells: DateCell[]; rules: Line[] } | null
doc: Finds the merged cells of the DATE column: the space between two consecutive horizontal rules that cross the whole column.
